canonical_runtime_protocol.reason: Independent outcome-bearing abstention evidence from RSCB-MC, together with clinical GSEM/MedExpMem evidence, now supports promoting empty-memory preservation from an additive probe to a generic runtime safety invariant while keeping science-performance claims scoped.

new_observations.text: RSCB-MC makes no_memory and abstain first-class memory-controller actions. On 32 hard negatives, static hybrid retrieval reports 75.0% false-positive injection and 100.0% unsafe injection, while full RSCB-MC reports 0.0% false positives and 100.0% correct safe non-injection.

RSCB-MC supplies direct outcome-bearing abstention ablation evidence: full deterministic offline replay has 0.0% false-positive memory injection and cumulative reward -31.740; removing abstention/non-injection actions raises false positives to 17.5% and worsens cumulative reward to -87.800. Domain scope is coding agents.

MedExpMem performs anatomical scoping, similarity-threshold retrieval, and an LLM relevance pass, yet harmful correct-to-incorrect memory effects remain nonzero across all seven reported model settings (1.3%-5.8%). Clinical retrieval filtering therefore does not eliminate admission risk.

CogEEGAgent separates semantic routing from scientific admissibility: on its prespecified routing benchmark the shared deterministic preflight gives correct abstention on 60/60 repeated required-abstention records and releases 0/60, while the LLM router is exact on 39/40 valid unique requests.

CogEEGAgent's deterministic boundary blocks all 200 internally inconsistent contract mutations, matches 20/20 source-frozen runtime lifecycle cases, and its public verifier matches 188/188 hard-failure outcomes across scalar, cluster, no-call, malformed-value, contradiction and evidence-binding cases.

CogEEGAgent simultaneously demonstrates the deterministic boundary's semantic limit: preflight accepts all 40/40 internally consistent wrong-template substitutions, and the one LLM routing error is internally consistent and released. Admissibility/contract consistency is therefore not semantic truth.

CogEEGAgent's prospective release state derives Released from contract validation, atomic commitment before confirmation, one-time confirmation opening, typed finite evidence, independent replay, evidence/hash binding, falsification and source-frozen scorer acceptance; failed guards terminate in Abstained rather than Released.

CogEEGAgent's selection-aware scientific experiment reports uncorrected best-p false-positive rate 16.5% versus participant-disjoint held-out confirmation 4.9%, a reported 11.6-point reduction with 95% subject-cluster CI 11.0-12.1.

WorldEvolver supplies a science-environment post-prediction abstention design: a memory-conditioned frozen world model produces foresight with confidence q_t and only exposes it to the frozen agent when q_t >= tau; otherwise the agent receives an empty foresight signal.

WorldEvolver's fixed-agent oracle diagnostic shows unreliable signal exposure can be worse than abstention: ScienceWorld action accuracy is 0.271 with no foresight, 0.251 with noisy foresight and 0.281 with perfect foresight; ALFWorld is 0.385, 0.344 and 0.493 respectively.

In AgentBoard planning, the same WorldEvolver framework with Selective Foresight improves or ties the w/o-F variant in all eight agent/backbone/environment cells. On ScienceWorld the four pairs are 46.67->52.22, 62.22->63.33, 48.89->50.00 and 62.22->63.33. This is science-environment evidence, not an autonomous-research matched memory-admission experiment.

new_protocol_inferences.name: EMPTY_MEMORY_IS_A_VALID_RUNTIME_ACTION
new_protocol_inferences.text: No-memory/abstain must be represented as valid runtime outcomes rather than retrieval failure.

new_protocol_inferences.name: RETRIEVAL_FILTERING_DOES_NOT_DISCHARGE_ADMISSION_RISK
new_protocol_inferences.text: Domain scoping, similarity filtering and relevance ranking reduce mismatch but do not prove every retained memory is safe to influence the current action.

new_protocol_inferences.name: DETERMINISTIC_PREFLIGHT_OWNS_ADMISSIBILITY_NOT_SEMANTIC_TRUTH
new_protocol_inferences.text: Deterministic preflight may own fail-closed admissibility and lifecycle transitions, but semantic routing correctness remains a separate claim.

new_protocol_inferences.name: RELEASE_STATE_MUST_BE_DERIVED_FROM_EVIDENCE_BOUND_TRANSITIONS
new_protocol_inferences.text: Scientific release/completion should be derived from typed evidence, immutable commitments, freshness/partition constraints, independent replay and deterministic transition checks rather than model prose/self-verification.

new_protocol_inferences.name: SEMANTIC_ERROR_CONTAINMENT_IS_DISTINCT_FROM_SEMANTIC_ERROR_PREVENTION
new_protocol_inferences.text: When semantic fit cannot be deterministically adjudicated, lifecycle control should still prevent unsupported evidence release or forbidden reuse; containment and route correctness must be reported separately.

new_protocol_inferences.name: ADAPTIVE_SELECTION_REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION_BOUND_RELEASE
new_protocol_inferences.text: Adaptively selected scientific evidence should not inherit release authority merely because it is numerically valid; bind release to a prespecified correction or disjoint confirmation resource with commitment before confirmation access.

new_protocol_inferences.name: POST_PREDICTION_SIGNAL_EXPOSURE_SHOULD_SUPPORT_EMPTY_OUTPUT
new_protocol_inferences.text: A generated or retrieved support signal should not influence downstream reasoning merely because it exists; an exposure layer should be able to emit an empty signal when confidence/admissibility is insufficient.

new_protocol_inferences.name: GATE_EFFECT_EVALUATION_MUST_DISTINGUISH_NO_SIGNAL_FROM_ALWAYS_EXPOSE
new_protocol_inferences.text: Selective-gate versus no-signal evidence supports usefulness of gated assistance but does not by itself quantify safety benefit over always exposing every candidate.

residual_dependency_findings: RSCB-MC and MedExpMem depend on model/tool execution and are memory-control evidence rather than scheduled-Chat parity routes.
CogEEGAgent provides strong autonomous-science control-plane evidence but requires deterministic scientific execution, data, routing and replay; it is not zero-external-executor Phase-1 acceptance.
WorldEvolver requires model/environment execution; ScienceWorld results support selective signal exposure but do not establish autonomous-research parity.
